lines.zh: 我踩着落叶走，脚步很轻
lines.en: I walk on fallen leaves with a light step.
The quiver taps softly at my hip.

lines.zh: 我沿着林缘走，不走进深处
lines.en: I follow the treeline, never going deep.
I check the ground before each step.

lines.zh: 弓背在肩上，我走得很稳
lines.en: Bow on my shoulder, I walk steadily.
I walk around your footprints.
My boots press the grass with almost no sound.

lines.zh: 我走一段就回头看一眼
lines.en: Every few steps I glance back.

lines.zh: 我把身影藏在树影里挪
lines.en: I shift along inside the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 腰间的绳子磨得沙沙响
lines.en: The cord at my waist rasps as I move.
I cross the shallow stream on stones.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是为了不惊动你
lines.en: I walk slowly so I don't startle you.
I pause to choose my next step.

lines.zh: 我沿坡走，保持在上风处
lines.en: I keep upwind along the slope.
A branch snags my cloak.
I duck low through the brush.

lines.zh: 我把箭在指间转了一圈
lines.en: I spin an arrow between my fingers.
I test the bowstring's pull.
I crouch and watch the distance.
Wind from the left. Noted.

lines.zh: 我数着箭袋里还剩几支
lines.en: I count the arrows left in the quiver.
I smooth a damp fletching flat.
I stand utterly still in the tree shadow.
I chew a grass stem and listen to the wood.
I check the bow's limbs for cracks.
Birds burst up far off; I look up.
I fasten my cloak's clasp.
I slow my breathing right down.
I wind the spare string around my wrist.
The sunlight slides past my boot tips.
I close my eyes and listen a while.

lines.zh: 我又睁开眼，什么都没变
lines.en: I open them again; nothing has changed.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，你已经进了射程
lines.en: I look up: you're already in range.
Hold still; I'm judging the distance.
I've noted the ground you stand on.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太响，早暴露了
lines.en: Your steps are loud; you gave yourself away.
I take the bow from my shoulder.
There's no cover between us.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你的护甲缝隙
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the gaps in your armour.
You don't look like prey.

lines.zh: 但你还是走进了我的林子
lines.en: And yet you walked into my wood.
My fingers find the string.
Move, and I'll call it fleeing.
So we simply look at each other.
I grunt and give half a step.
You broke my aim.
Blood seeps through my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我按住伤处，眼睛没离开你
lines.en: I press the wound, eyes still on you.
That blow changed my mind.

lines.zh: 我的弓弦被削断了一股
lines.en: One strand of my string is cut.
Pain makes me grit my teeth.
I step back, and not to flee.
You're tougher than I judged.
Fine. Now I'm serious.

lines.zh: 你露出的那点食物，我看见了
lines.en: I saw the food you let show.
I've been hungry a while; no point hiding it.
Set it down and step back three paces.
I won't snatch it; I'll wait for you to let go.

lines.zh: 这味道比林子里的果子重
lines.en: That smells heavier than any forest fruit.
My bow can go down for now.
Is there enough there for two?
Don't laugh. I really am hungry.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了半步，就半步
lines.en: I edge forward half a step. Only half.

lines.zh: 你收起来，我就当没看见
lines.en: Put it away and I'll pretend I saw nothing.

lines.zh: 陷阱我不碰，食物可以谈
lines.en: I won't touch a trap, but food is negotiable.

lines.zh: 我咽了下口水，声音很轻
lines.en: I swallow, quietly.
What do you want in trade for it?
I'll take it from you. Just this once.
When I've eaten, we settle accounts.
I can tell it isn't bait.
You knock me and the bow nearly slips.
I roll my shoulder to shed the impact.
Back off; don't crowd me.
Shoulder to shoulder, neither gives way.
That bump spoils my aim.
I push you off with an elbow.

lines.zh: 我被顶得后退，鞋底打滑
lines.en: I'm shoved back, boots sliding.
Keep off my quiver.

lines.zh: 撞完你才想起我背着弓
lines.en: Only after bumping me do you recall the bow.
Next time, announce yourself.
You lower your bow; I lower mine.
We'll take turns at watch. Agreed?

lines.zh: 我的箭袋里有两份干粮
lines.en: There are two rations in my quiver.
Save the warm side for me.
I'm not good at saying such things.
But there are only the two of us in this wood.
Let me restring your bow.
Your hands are steadier than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起走到林子尽头
lines.en: Let's walk to the wood's far edge together.
This time I'm not aiming at you.

lines.zh: 我捡起你射偏的那支箭
lines.en: I pick up the arrow you missed with.
The dropped fletching is still usable.

lines.zh: 我拾起一截硬木，留着做弓
lines.en: I take a length of hardwood for a bow.
This flint will strike a spark.
I tuck it into my belt pouch.
You dropped it; I'll hold it for you.
I pick it up and weigh it.
This will trade for a few good arrows.

lines.zh: 我弯腰很快，眼睛没离你
lines.en: I bend fast, eyes never leaving you.

lines.zh: 有用的我拿，没用的留给你
lines.en: I take what's useful and leave the rest.
You snapped a dry twig.

lines.zh: 我听见了，所以锁定了你
lines.en: I heard it, so you're marked.
Close enough; I start drawing.
The first arrow is yours.
You turn, and you're facing me.

lines.zh: 我算好你下一脚的位置
lines.en: I've worked out where your next step lands.
Target confirmed, and the wind agrees.
Run — that makes you easier to aim at.
I draw a deep breath and steady my hands.
I won't miss this time.
I correct the aim little by little.
You duck behind a tree; I shift position.

lines.zh: 拉弓时，我屏住自己的气。
lines.en: As I draw, I hold my own breath.
The string is full; just a bit more.
I wait for you to leave the tree's shadow.
Can you hear the string creak?

lines.zh: 我的准星压在你的膝上
lines.en: My aim sits on your knee.
No rush. I'm patient.

lines.zh: 你又挪了一步，我跟着转
lines.en: You shift again; I turn with you.
This arrow waits for your head to show.
You're close, so I switch to the blade.
I lunge, faster than before.
The flat comes first, the edge after.
You can stop arrows, not me.
I kick your weapon aside.
This cut goes for your wrist.
I fight close so you can't draw.
You retreat; I take one step after.
My hand is steady. You know that.

lines.zh: 挨这一下，等于挨一支箭
lines.en: This blow lands like an arrow.

lines.zh: 林子边缘，多了一个影子
lines.en: Another shadow at the treeline.
I take the bow off my back.
I know the sound of the wind here.
I pick a good tree to put my back to.

lines.zh: 靴印从远处一直到这里
lines.en: Bootprints run all the way here.
I'm here, and the prey doesn't know.
Quiver full, string tight.
First I take the upwind spot.
Another wood falls under my patrol.
Don't ask where I came from. Ask the arrow.
My sleeve catches fire; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 从坡上滑下来，肋骨发疼
lines.en: Sliding down the slope jars my ribs.

lines.zh: 水没过头顶，我憋着气挣
lines.en: Water closes over me; I struggle for breath.
The blast throws me into the brush.

lines.zh: 这一箭不偏不倚，正中我
lines.en: That arrow lands square on me.
The spell works into my bones like needles.
My hands shake and the bow won't hold steady.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我脚边，耳朵嗡嗡响
lines.en: Lightning strikes at my feet; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一路往下掉
lines.en: The ground vanishes and I fall on and on.
